marketing_description: The DeWALT DCD1007B hammer drill delivers 20 V MAX XR lithium‑ion power through a metal housing in black/yellow, with a 1/2 in keyless metal chuck and a rubber‑grip main handle for control. It provides 210 in‑lb of torque and a two‑speed trigger, delivering up to 38,250 bpm hammer action with forward/reverse control button.
